Y.M.C.A. CAMPAIGN REPORT LUNCHEONS 


sss a a ae SS ae Ea = == 
ose SSS SSS SSeS SSeS SSS SS SSS SES eS 


The progress of the Y's 1965 campaign will be reported at noon 
hour meetings to be held on March 30th, April 2, 6, and 9. 


The closing dinner is to be held on Monday April 12th. 


Speakers at the luncheons are: 

March 30th: Magnus Flynn, Dean of Students of Sir George Williams 
University will report on the intensive student leader training 
program conducted in co-operation with specialized Y staff. 

This project is the first of its kind at a Canadian University. 
April 2nd: Mac Singleton, Executive Secretary of the NDG-Y will 
speak on "First Aid to Failing Students". Outstanding succes has 
been achieved with this novel program at N.D.G. 

April 6th: Maurice Strong, President of the Power Corporation of 
Canada will be guest speaker. Mr. Strong is Chairman of the 
National Y.M.C.A. World Service Committee. 

April 9th: Ross Bannerman, Executive Secretary of the Lakeshore Y 
will speak on the Pincourt Teens Froject. The Y in co-operation 
with city officials and local residents has established a special 
Teen project in a house and has developed a youth committee to 


manage the program. 


All meetings are at 12:30 p.m. in the Downtown Y.M.C.A. A press 


table is provided.
